content:
As the launch of the iPhone Duo approaches, Apple is now accepting submissions for apps and games built with Xcode 27.1 and optimised for iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

App Store Connect will require iPhone Duo screenshots for submissions starting April 2027

Over the past few weeks, Apple has released beta versions of Xcode 27.1 to support the building and testing of apps and games for iPhone Duo. Apple today released Xcode 27.1 Release Candidate 1, which developers can download here.

Earlier this evening, Apple published an article on its Developer News Hub, announcing that developers can now submit apps and games optimised for iPhone Duo on App Store Connect:

When you build or rebuild with Xcode 27.1, your App Store product page will display a badge letting users know your app has been optimised for iPhone Duo.

Apple specifically noted that starting April 2027, any app or game submitted to App Store Connect must include iPhone Duo screenshots.

In the same news article, Apple highlighted that rebuilding existing apps with Xcode 27.1 can add iPhone Duo development support, and developers can use the Device Hub to preview how their apps will run on the new device in various postures and orientations.

Apple also listed several resources to help developers prepare their apps and App Store product pages for iPhone Duo, including:

  • Get design guidelines and templates
  • Manage your App Store assets
  • View app preview specifications
  • View screenshot specifications

Apple will also be holding several iPhone Duo in-person workshops in the coming days. For details and registration, click here.

iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with deliveries and retail availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced that users can get ready for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12. You can read the details here.
